summary: Version 1 of the TikZ figure compiles and passes validation and topology checks (all six labels A, B, D, E, F, O present, no missing edges). The automatic Critic scored it 0.92 with must_repair=false. It reproduces the circle centred at O, the vertical diameter AB, the horizontal chord EF through D, the solid AE and AF, and the dashed OE and OF, using the measured pixel coordinates.
